dyed-flax-fibres-georgia.description: Two weathered hands in a dark, firelit cave twist a thin plant fibre into a thread; one hand rests on a rounded, fleshy surface and a bundle of stripped, multicoloured fibres lies on the rocky ground beside them. A fire glows orange at the upper left. The painting is loose and oil-like, filling the whole square with no visible border.

silk-weaving-china-legend.description: An oil-style painting of a woman in an ornate gold-embroidered dark silk robe with a mandarin collar, seated in a dim courtyard under a leafy branch. She pinches a fine thread rising from a small steaming patterned bowl holding a pale cocoon-like object. A carved lattice window is behind her. No text, border or frame, nothing graphic.

victoria-white-wedding-gown.description: A woman seen from behind in a long ivory satin gown with an off-shoulder lace bodice and a long lace-edged train, wearing a veil and a flower wreath. She stands in a dark Gothic-style chapel with wood paneling and lit candles on the altar, while a priest in white vestments waits. Men in military dress uniforms and women in gowns line the aisle, and onlookers watch from a gallery above. It reads as a 19th-century oil painting, with no visible text and no frame.

worth-paris-couture-house.description: A painted interior of an ornate salon with gilt-framed mirrors and wall sconces lit with candles. A woman with her hair pinned up stands in profile wearing a full green satin gown with ruffles and bows and a wide skirt. A seated woman in black watches with her hand to her chin. A man in a dark waistcoat kneels at the hem, adjusting the skirt. Dress and furniture suggest the mid-19th century. There is no visible text and no frame.

burberry-gabardine.description: A belted, double-breasted tan coat with a diagonal herringbone-like weave hangs on a wooden peg in a dark workshop. Droplets of water bead and run down its surface. Rolled bolts of dark fabric sit on a plank shelf below, with a pair of shears hanging on the wall to the right and a paper pattern pinned to the wall at upper right. The scene is a dim, warm-toned oil painting filling the whole frame edge to edge.

viscose-rayon-patented.description: A painted scene of an old laboratory bench. A glass funnel with brass taps drips amber liquid into a beaker, and a pair of hands draws fine glistening strands from the liquid onto a crank-driven spool. Wooden logs with bark and wood shavings lie in the foreground, with an oil lamp glowing at left and glass bottles on the bench. A man in a leather apron stands at right. No visible text, frame or border, and nothing gory.

lacoste-polo-shirt.description: A white short-sleeved polo shirt with a small green crocodile logo lies folded on a wooden table beside a vintage wooden tennis racket and two worn tennis balls. A clay court with a net sits in the dim background. The style is dark and painterly, with no people visible.

hepburn-givenchy-black-dress.description: A black sleeveless, floor-length gown with long black gloves and a multi-strand pearl necklace sits on a dress-form mannequin, standing on a city sidewalk. Behind it, a shop window shows jewellery on display busts, and a takeaway coffee cup and pastry sit on the sill. The style is loose, painterly oil with no visible text, frame or border, and the image runs edge to edge.

monroe-sheer-birthday-dress.description: A painted dark stage scene. A dress form, wearing a sheer nude-toned gown covered in small sparkling studs or crystals, stands under a single warm spotlight beam from above. A vintage chrome microphone on a tall stand sits to the right. The background is near-black with faint brushed texture, and the floor is lit in dim amber. A tiny mark sits in the bottom-right corner. No people are visible.

von-furstenberg-wrap-dress.description: A painting of a long-sleeved wrap dress with a bold blue, green and cream abstract print, tied at the waist, displayed on a dressmaker's form in a dark room. Beside it is a grey manual typewriter with paper stacked on a wooden desk, a brown leather briefcase on the floor, and a window with venetian blinds. No people, no visible text.
